snippet.title: Snapstick | Release Trailer | Meta Quest Platform
snippet.description:
500+ puzzles by the multi-award-winning puzzle designer of Linelight
60+ original mechanics
Featuring music by the legendary Grant Kirkhope (Banjo-Kazooie, GoldenEye 007, and many, many more)

Snapstick releases on Meta Quest October 3rd 2024!

Get it here: https://metaque.st/4eLFzRi
